--- title: "Bayesian Analysis of Task Difficulty and Interest Ratings (Pilot Study)" author: "Przemyslaw Marcowski, PhD" date: "today" --- ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code code-fold="true"} library(tidyverse) library(BayesFactor) library(bayestestR) # Select confidence interval ci_level <- 0.99 ci_pct <- sprintf("%d%%", round(ci_level * 100)) set.seed(42) # for reproducibility # Prepare data for each experiment # source("../R/prepare_data.R") # Optional: prepares to `data/prepared/` ``` ::: # Data Import Prepared pilot data comparing task difficulty and interest ratings between experimental and survey contexts. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Read pilot data pilot_data <- readRDS("../data/prepared/pilot.Rds") pilot_data ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: # Descriptive Statistics Mean, standard deviation, and sample size for each rating measure across both contexts. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Calculate descriptive statistics descriptive_stats <- pilot_data %>% summarize( experiment_hard_mean = mean(experiment_hard, na.rm = TRUE), experiment_hard_sd = sd(experiment_hard, na.rm = TRUE), experiment_hard_n = sum(!is.na(experiment_hard)), survey_hard_mean = mean(survey_hard, na.rm = TRUE), survey_hard_sd = sd(survey_hard, na.rm = TRUE), survey_hard_n = sum(!is.na(survey_hard)), experiment_interesting_mean = mean(experiment_interesting, na.rm = TRUE), experiment_interesting_sd = sd(experiment_interesting, na.rm = TRUE), experiment_interesting_n = sum(!is.na(experiment_interesting)), survey_interesting_mean = mean(survey_interesting, na.rm = TRUE), survey_interesting_sd = sd(survey_interesting, na.rm = TRUE), survey_interesting_n = sum(!is.na(survey_interesting)) ) %>% pivot_longer( cols = everything(), names_to = c("task", "measure", "stat"), names_pattern = "(.*)_(.*)_(.*)", values_to = "value" ) %>% pivot_wider( names_from = stat, values_from = value ) %>% mutate( task = str_to_title(task), measure = case_when( measure == "hard" ~ "Difficulty", measure == "interesting" ~ "Interest", TRUE ~ measure ) ) descriptive_stats ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Save Descriptive Statistics ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Save results (Optional: saves to `output/`) # write_csv(descriptive_stats, "../output/pilot_descriptive_stats.csv") ``` ::: # Bayesian Analysis Bayesian paired t-tests comparing experimental vs. survey ratings for difficulty and interest, using a medium Cauchy prior (r = 0.707) on the effect size. ## Task Difficulty Ratings ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Bayesian paired t-test for task difficulty ratings difficulty_bf <- ttestBF( x = pilot_data$experiment_hard, y = pilot_data$survey_hard, paired = TRUE, rscale = 0.707 ) difficulty_bf ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Bayes factor analysis -------------- [1] Alt., r=0.707 : 8.171385e+18 ±0% Against denominator: Null, mu = 0 --- Bayes factor type: BFoneSample, JZS ``` ::: ::: ### Posterior Samples ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Extract posterior samples difficulty_posterior <- posterior(difficulty_bf, iterations = 10000) difficulty_effect <- difficulty_posterior[, "delta"] ``` ::: ### Summary Statistics ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Calculate summary statistics for task difficulty ratings difficulty_hdi <- hdi(difficulty_effect, ci = ci_level) difficulty_mean <- mean(difficulty_effect) difficulty_bf_value <- extractBF(difficulty_bf)$bf cat("Mean effect (delta):", difficulty_mean, "\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Mean effect (delta): 1.370696 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat(ci_pct, "HDI:", difficulty_hdi$CI_low, "-", difficulty_hdi$CI_high, "\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 99% HDI: 0.9914789 - 1.770192 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat("Bayes Factor:", difficulty_bf_value, "\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Bayes Factor: 8.171385e+18 ``` ::: ::: ## Task Interest Ratings ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Bayesian paired t-test for appeal ratings interest_bf <- ttestBF( x = pilot_data$experiment_interesting, y = pilot_data$survey_interesting, paired = TRUE, rscale = 0.707 ) interest_bf ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Bayes factor analysis -------------- [1] Alt., r=0.707 : 2.499019e+20 ±0% Against denominator: Null, mu = 0 --- Bayes factor type: BFoneSample, JZS ``` ::: ::: ### Posterior Samples ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Extract posterior samples interest_posterior <- posterior(interest_bf, iterations = 10000) interest_effect <- interest_posterior[, "delta"] ``` ::: ### Summary Statistics ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Calculate summary statistics for appeal ratings interest_hdi <- hdi(interest_effect, ci = ci_level) interest_mean <- mean(interest_effect) interest_bf_value <- extractBF(interest_bf)$bf cat("Mean effect (delta):", interest_mean, "\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Mean effect (delta): 1.453248 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat(ci_pct, "HDI:", interest_hdi$CI_low, "-", interest_hdi$CI_high, "\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` 99% HDI: 1.040366 - 1.856866 ``` ::: ```{.r .cell-code} cat("Bayes Factor:", interest_bf_value, "\n") ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Bayes Factor: 2.499019e+20 ``` ::: ::: # Results Summary Posterior mean effect sizes (Cohen's *d*), 99% HDIs, and Bayes Factors for both comparisons. ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Set up data for plotting effect_data <- data.frame( Measure = rep(c("Difficulty", "Interest"), each = length(difficulty_effect)), Effect = c(difficulty_effect, interest_effect) ) # Create summary table for the Bayesian analysis pilot_summary <- tibble( Measure = c("Difficulty", "Interest"), Comparison = c("Experiment vs. Survey", "Experiment vs. Survey"), Post_Mean_d = c(difficulty_mean, interest_mean), HDI_low = c(difficulty_hdi$CI_low, interest_hdi$CI_low), HDI_high = c(difficulty_hdi$CI_high, interest_hdi$CI_high), Bayes_Factor = c(difficulty_bf_value, interest_bf_value), Log_BF = c(log(difficulty_bf_value), log(interest_bf_value)) ) pilot_summary ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} `````{=html}
````` ::: ::: ## Save Results ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} # Save results (Optional: saves to `output/`) # write_csv(pilot_summary, "../output/pilot_test_summary.csv") ``` ::: # Session ::: {.cell} ```{.r .cell-code} sessionInfo() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` R version 4.5.1 (2025-06-13 ucrt) Platform: x86_64-w64-mingw32/x64 Running under: Windows 11 x64 (build 26200) Matrix products: default LAPACK version 3.12.1 locale: [1] LC_COLLATE=English_United States.utf8 [2] LC_CTYPE=English_United States.utf8 [3] LC_MONETARY=English_United States.utf8 [4] LC_NUMERIC=C [5] LC_TIME=English_United States.utf8 time zone: America/Los_Angeles tzcode source: internal attached base packages: [1] stats graphics grDevices utils datasets methods base other attached packages: [1] bayestestR_0.17.0 BayesFactor_0.9.12-4.7 Matrix_1.7-4 [4] coda_0.19-4.1 lubridate_1.9.4 forcats_1.0.1 [7] stringr_1.6.0 dplyr_1.2.0 purrr_1.2.1 [10] readr_2.1.6 tidyr_1.3.2 tibble_3.3.1 [13] ggplot2_4.0.2 tidyverse_2.0.0 loaded via a namespace (and not attached): [1] generics_0.1.4 stringi_1.8.7 lattice_0.22-7 hms_1.1.4 [5] digest_0.6.39 magrittr_2.0.4 evaluate_1.0.5 grid_4.5.1 [9] timechange_0.4.0 RColorBrewer_1.1-3 mvtnorm_1.3-3 fastmap_1.2.0 [13] jsonlite_2.0.0 scales_1.4.0 pbapply_1.7-4 cli_3.6.5 [17] rlang_1.1.7 withr_3.0.2 yaml_2.3.12 otel_0.2.0 [21] tools_4.5.1 parallel_4.5.1 tzdb_0.5.0 MatrixModels_0.5-4 [25] vctrs_0.7.1 R6_2.6.1 lifecycle_1.0.5 htmlwidgets_1.6.4 [29] insight_1.4.5 pkgconfig_2.0.3 pillar_1.11.1 gtable_0.3.6 [33] glue_1.8.0 Rcpp_1.1.1 xfun_0.56 tidyselect_1.2.1 [37] knitr_1.51 dichromat_2.0-0.1 farver_2.1.2 htmltools_0.5.9 [41] rmarkdown_2.30 compiler_4.5.1 S7_0.2.1 ``` ::: :::
